title: murtaza ke gulshan me kya bahaar aayi hai
body:
murtaza ke gulshan me kya bahaar aayi hai
rehmate quda ban kar chaar soo jo chayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo noor bikhra hai fatima ki godi hai
mujtaba ke jalwe me shaane mustafayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ali ka beta hai jiska mujtaba hai naam
har bulandi choukhat par sajda karne aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad hai ali be had aur fatima qush hai
aaj unke dil ki jo aarzoo bar aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj ham ghulaamou ke dil bhala na ho kyu khush
murtuza o zahra ke ghar me eid aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jamma hai mohib saare aaj dar pe hyder ke
tehniyat ke naarou se goonjti qudaayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
noor se munawwar hai aaj ghar jo hyder ka
noore panjetan ki ye chouthi shamma aati hai
